experiment_Name: Method B v36 CODE-ACCORD expanded passage, matched cases
experiment_Description: Controlled non-direct-QA comparison, Method B. Reuses v36's v35 single-pass baseline and bounded ReAct controller with five tools, four steps, a 6000 output-token budget, a three-consecutive-malformed-call limit, and baseline fallback. Per-run traces report finalized improvements, harmful revisions, unchanged fallbacks, tool failures, tokens, and runtime. Uses the same Gemma 4 31B, temperature 1.0, and five repetitions as direct-QA reference runs. Historical Exp. 73 used Gemma 3 27B and Exp. 72/v35; its 301/1080 versus 287/1080 aggregate difference includes fallbacks and is descriptive, not evidence of finalized-agent superiority.
